info.title: DecisionTrace first-slice API
info.description: Partial local contract. Governed source versioning, bounded intake, decision review, exact citations, source revocation, and reviewable downstream change watches are implemented. Tenant and role come from a verified demo or OIDC token. Other operations remain planned.

post.summary: Revoke all versions of an authored source and remove answer/index visibility
Link an approved decision to a downstream source version

409.description: Decision is not approved or link exists

get.summary: List authorized watches and source-version change findings

post.summary: Independently classify one observed downstream source version

409.description: Stale version, creator review, or already reviewed

get.summary: Resolve the verified account, tenant, and role

post.summary: Stream a bounded UTF-8 Markdown, transcript, or JSON file into governed source versioning
Push a checksummed revision from an enabled connector
Append a corrected or updated source version

get.summary: Open an authorized exact source version

post.summary: Approve or reject a versioned decision
Ask a temporal question with scoped citations
Queue evaluation against a pinned corpus manifest

content.description: Returned only to an authorized reader.

sections.description: Deterministic section IDs and exact character spans for this source version.
